name: Paneer and Spinach Stuffed Besan Chilla
steps: Whisk besan, water, ajwain, turmeric, cumin and salt into a smooth batter; rest 5 minutes.
Wilt spinach in a dry pan for 1–2 minutes. Cool, squeeze lightly and mix with paneer, onion and coriander.
Heat a non-stick pan and brush with a little oil. Pour half the batter and spread into a thin round.
Cook until the top sets, flip, add half the paneer-spinach filling to one side and fold over.
Cook 1 minute more to warm the filling. Repeat with remaining batter and serve.
note: Vegetarian, not vegan. Protein estimate depends on paneer brand and besan quantity.
